scenes.name: BLOCH SPHERE
lines: Pure qubits are points on the sphere; each Bloch matrix squares to one.
纯量子比特态是球面上的点 v；每个布洛赫矩阵都满足 B(v)² = I₂。
The Born weight on zero is cosine squared of half the angle.
落在 |0⟩ 上的玻恩权重是半角余弦的平方：cos²(θ/2) = (1 + cos θ)/2。

scenes.name: GEOMETRIC PRODUCT
lines: The geometric product splits: cosine theta along the line, sine theta as area.
几何积一分为二：沿线的 cos θ，与作为有向面积的 sin θ Î。
Particle and wave: their squares add to one.
一为粒子，一为波：cos²θ + sin²θ = 1。

scenes.name: SANDWICH ROTOR
lines: A rotor turns half the angle, from both sides.
旋子只转半角，从两侧夹住向量：R(α) v R(α)†。
The axis commutes, so it stays put.
沿旋转轴的分量与旋子对易，原地不动。
The plane anti-commutes: two halves make one full turn.
垂直平面内的分量与 Î 反对易：两个半角合成一整个 α。

scenes.name: SPINOR 2π SIGN
lines: At three sixty, the arrow is home, but the rotor reads minus one.
转过 360°，箭头回到原处，旋子却是 R(2π) = −I₂。
Only at seven twenty does it read plus one again.
要转满 720°，旋子才回到 R(4π) = +I₂。
